privacy.p1: LensClick values the privacy of its clients and visitors. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and share your personal information when using our site and services.
privacy.sec1.li1: Information provided by the user: Account, personal and professional profile, contact, newsletter, and project request data.
privacy.sec1.li2: Essential technical information: Session cookies and temporary connection data used for security and abuse prevention.
privacy.sec1.title: 1. Information Collected
privacy.sec10.p: This policy may be updated periodically. We recommend that you review this page regularly.
privacy.sec10.title: 10. Policy Changes
privacy.sec11.p: The officer responsible for personal data processing can be reached at lensclick.fotografias@gmail.com to exercise rights, clarify doubts, or address any matter covered by this policy.
privacy.sec11.title: 11. Data Protection Officer (DPO)
privacy.sec12.p: We use cloud infrastructure providers based abroad (currently Cloudflare, with operations in the United States). In such cases, the transfer is supported by contractual clauses and security measures compatible with the LGPD, ensuring an equivalent level of protection for your data.
privacy.sec12.title: 12. International Data Transfer
privacy.sec13.p: You have the right to file a complaint with the Brazilian National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) if you believe your data is being processed in violation of applicable law.
privacy.sec13.title: 13. Right to File a Complaint (ANPD)
privacy.sec14.p: For privacy questions, contact us at lensclick.fotografias@gmail.com.
privacy.sec14.title: 14. Contact
privacy.sec2.li1: Account and profile data: contract performance and the data subject’s consent.
privacy.sec2.li2: Session cookie and security counters: legitimate interest (security, abuse prevention, and essential service operation).
privacy.sec2.li3: Contact messages and quotes: consent and pre-contractual steps.
privacy.sec2.li4: Newsletter and communications: the data subject’s consent, revocable at any time.
privacy.sec2.p: Every personal data processing activity carried out by LensClick has a legal basis under the LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law):
privacy.sec2.title: 2. Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.sec3.li1: Respond to questions, requests, and quotes.
privacy.sec3.li2: Improve our services and user experience.
privacy.sec3.li3: Send communications, news, and promotions (with consent).
privacy.sec3.title: 3. Use of Information
privacy.sec4.p: We use cloud infrastructure providers, currently Cloudflare (Workers, D1 and R2), strictly to operate and protect the service. Professional profiles become public only when the photographer enables publishing; email and phone each require individual permission. Other disclosures occur only when necessary to provide contracted services or when required by law.
privacy.sec4.title: 4. Data Sharing
privacy.sec5.p: Passwords are stored using a cryptographic hash, and authenticated sessions use an essential, HTTP-only cookie. No system can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.sec5.title: 5. Security
privacy.sec6.p: We use only an essential cookie to maintain the authenticated session. The language preference is saved on the device and no analytics cookies are used by LensClick.
privacy.sec6.title: 6. Cookies
privacy.sec7.li1: Access, correction, or deletion of your personal data.
privacy.sec7.title: 7. User Rights
privacy.sec8.li1: Account data, sessions and profile photo: kept while the account is active and deleted immediately upon account closure.
privacy.sec8.li3: Contact messages and quotes: kept until deletion is requested through the privacy channel.
privacy.sec8.li4: Newsletter subscriptions: kept until consent is revoked.
privacy.sec8.li5: Security counters: irreversible identifiers that expire automatically within up to 1 hour.
privacy.sec8.li6: Infrastructure provider technical records: follow their own operational retention periods and legal obligations.
privacy.sec8.p: Retention periods vary by data category, according to the purpose of the processing:
privacy.sec8.title: 8. Retention and Deletion
privacy.sec9.p: LensClick is intended for users aged 18 and over and we do not knowingly process personal data of minors. If we identify the processing of a minor's data without the specific and highlighted consent of a parent or legal guardian (LGPD art. 14), the data will be deleted.
privacy.sec9.title: 9. Data of Minors
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
